historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2025 -> FY2035: -9.5%, -3%, 0%, then 1.5-2%), which compounds to ~0%. The equity CAGR is rejected as a growth proxy: it is inflated by the October 2024 IPO proceeds (equity 6,903 -> 11,300 in FY2024), not retained earnings.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR +24.4% vs revenue 3yr CAGR -4.5% and net income 3yr CAGR -0.2%: the divergence is the IPO capital raise, not organic compounding. Owner FCF (reported FCF less interest income; SBC is zero) was negative in all three years with a cash-flow statement (FY2023 -787.6, FY2024 -759.6, FY2025 -258.8) because capex ran at 13-17% of revenue through the 1+N capacity build, so no FCF CAGR is computable. EPS 2yr CAGR -21% is worse than net income (-0.2% 3yr) because the IPO added 398m shares.
historical_growth.notes: History: FY2021-FY2025 revenue 11,340 / 12,623 / 13,515 / 13,521 / 11,002; attributable net income 858 / 990 / 1,329 / 1,637 / 985. FY2020 is not in the Metrics file so 5-year CAGRs are unavailable. The company is two years into a share-loss downturn, so historical averages are not the forecast basis; the driver paths are anchored on H1 2026 actuals and the H2 2025 trough.

scenario_narratives.base: Shrink, then stabilise at a smaller scale. The bear axis is the purified-water price war: C'estbon lost ~25 points of segment share to Nongfu Spring's green-label discounting in 2024-25 and revenue fell 18.6% in FY2025 and 12.1% in H1 2026. The base case assumes the late-2025 regulatory push against 'involutionary' pricing slows the decline (H2 2026 ~-5%, FY2027 -3%) and that the company holds its reduced ~45% share rather than regaining it, growing with the ~2% category thereafter. Ex-interest EBITDA margin rebuilds from 16.5% to 18% (not FY2024's 19.5%) as discounting eases, and capex falls to ~D&A once Danjiangkou is commissioned end-2026, turning a capacity-build cash drain into ~RMB700m/yr of owner FCF. Roughly half of equity value is the RMB7.3bn cash pile, which the Dividend Plan (>=RMB0.37/sh FY2026-28) and the HK$530m buyback are returning.
scenario_narratives.bull: Price war ends and the second curve works. Regulators enforce the anti-involution stance, Nongfu stops subsidising purified water, and H2 2026 revenue is flat YoY. Share stabilises, bulk/large-format water and the home-delivery and bulk-snack channels add volume, and the beverage portfolio (Zhi Ben Qing Run herbal tea, sugar-free tea, juice, sports drinks) resumes growth from its H1 2026 reset base, lifting group growth to 5% in FY2028-29 and margin to 21% by FY2031 on mix and a fully loaded self-owned plant network. This needs three independent things to go right (pricing discipline from a competitor, share stabilisation, beverage execution), which is why it carries 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural share loss in a commodity. Water is 86-89% of revenue and undifferentiated; Nongfu Spring, Wahaha and Master Kong can price purified water as a loss-leader for broader portfolios indefinitely. Share keeps sliding, H2 2026 is as weak as H1 (-12%), FY2027 -8%, and revenue bottoms near RMB8bn in FY2031. Sports sponsorship (TEAM CHINA, three football tiers) and the new plant are fixed costs on a shrinking base, so ex-interest EBITDA margin settles at 12.5%, close to H2 2025's 10.2%. Owner FCF stays positive (~RMB300-400m) because capex falls to maintenance, so the business survives and the cash pile dominates the value; there is no solvency axis, only a 'melting ice cube' axis.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a shrinking, cash-rich commodity-water business on the cash it can produce at a smaller stable scale, not on FY2024 peak margins or on historical averages that pre-date the price war. Interest income is stripped and the RMB7.3bn of deposits and WMPs added in the bridge; dividends already declared but unpaid, and NCI, are deducted so the equity value is what a buyer at today's price actually owns. Risk is charged once, in the driver paths and the 30/50/20 weights, at a single CNY-built 9% discount rate. Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF because a share-losing water bottler is not a compounder. House and street bases coincide (no SBC).
key_risks_to_valuation: Share loss continues beyond FY2027: every 1pp of permanently lower revenue is worth roughly RMB0.02/share; the bear path (-27% trough) is the lower bound of what is modelled, not of what can happen
Margin: ex-interest EBITDA margin was 10.2% in H2 2025; if the H2 2026 print is similar the base 16.5% FY2026 margin is too high and the recovery to 18% is in doubt
Capex does not normalise: if the 1+N build continues at 13-15% of revenue after Danjiangkou, owner FCF stays near zero and the equity is worth little more than net cash

Capital allocation of the cash pile: RMB2.1bn of deposits sit with a fellow China Resources subsidiary; the >=RMB0.37/sh dividend floor exceeds projected owner FCF and relies on the pile, which is fine while it is returned to shareholders and not if it is redeployed into the group
FX: the quote is HKD and the flows CNY; a 5% CNY depreciation against HKD moves the HKD value 5% with no change in the business
Terminal assumptions: ~55-60% of EV in the base case is terminal value at a 15x cap; a 12x cap or 1% terminal growth is worth roughly HK$0.4-0.5/share

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,398,196,600 ordinary shares; basic = diluted (no share option or award scheme; H1 2026 interim report note 9). Held FLAT. The HK$530m buyback mandate (June 30, 2026) had not been exercised by the interim report date; any repurchase is value-neutral in this model and is funded from the cash already in the bridge.
inputs.cash_composition: 30 Jun 2026, RMB m: cash and cash equivalents 821.923 + current fixed bank deposits 4,846.537 + non-current fixed bank deposits 1,406.659 + financial assets at FVTPL (wealth-management products) 250.693 = 7,325.812. RMB 2,073.2m of the deposits sit with a fellow China Resources subsidiary (related-party bank). Lease liabilities (25.835) excluded from debt under lease treatment (B).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report: no share-based payment expense and no share option/award scheme; SBC-zero market, rows kept explicit at 0%
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T22:01Z). All flows and per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1724 to the HKD quote. No dual listing to parity-check; cross-check: the company converted its H1 2026 interim dividend at RMB1 = HKD1.15582 (PBOC central parity, 5 days to 26 Aug 2026), 1.4% below the October spot, consistent in direction and magnitude. The rate is dated; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' own currency: China 10y CGB ~1.8% (Oct 2026) + China equity risk premium ~6.5% x beta ~1.0 for an HK-listed China consumer staple, plus ~0.7pp for a 2024-IPO SOE subsidiary with a short public record = cost of equity ~9.0%. Debt is RMB13m against RMB7.3bn of cash, so WACC = cost of equity = 9.0%. Same rate across all three scenarios: cyclicality, share loss and governance risk are charged once, in the flows and the weights.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal ~RMB16.5m + interest ~RMB1.2m, H1 2026 run-rate 8.1m + 0.6m) deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path = 0.16% of revenue; lease liabilities (RMB25.8m) excluded from net debt; da_pct_path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A 823.9 less ROU depreciation ~30 = ~794 = 7.2% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; non-controlling interests deducted once, at book (RMB599.383m, 30 Jun 2026) in equity_bridge. NCI took RMB23.1m of FY2025 profit (2.3%), so book is at or above the NCI's economic value; attributable-only flows via a leakage rate would deduct less. FY0 tie: FY2025 ex-interest EBITDA 1,767 - lease 18 - D&A ex-ROU 794 = EBIT 955; at the reported 17.1% effective rate NOPAT 792 vs profit incl. NCI 1,008 less after-tax interest income 206 = 802; ties within noise.
inputs.ebitda_margin_basis: ebitda_margin_path is EBITDA EXCLUDING interest income (interest income is stripped and the cash it earns is added in the bridge). Actuals on this basis: FY2023 16.2%, FY2024 19.5%, FY2025 16.1% (H1 20.6% / H2 10.2% price-war trough), H1 2026 20.9% (seasonal peak half). Government grants (~RMB75m H1 2026) and recycled-packaging sales remain inside EBITDA as recurring other operating income.
inputs.cash_tax_basis: 25% PRC statutory cash rate in every year of every scenario. FY2025 cash tax was 9.6% of PBT (RMB117m) and the FY2025 effective rate 17.1%, both one-off lows against FY2023 29.1%, FY2024 25.3%, H1 2026 26.1%; FY2025 is NOT a repeatable base. The engine applies tax to max(0, EBIT), so no credit is booked on a loss.
inputs.base_year_note: FY0 = FY2025 (year to 31 Dec 2025), revenue RMB11,002.1m. Year 1 = FY2026, of which H1 is reported (revenue -12.1%, ex-interest EBITDA margin 20.9%, capex RMB359.7m). FY2025 reported FCF of RMB15.8m and owner FCF of -RMB258.8m are not a usable base: H1 2025 booked RMB1.1bn of working-capital inflow (contract liabilities +402m, payables +722m) that unwound in H2 2025 (H2 OCF -RMB749m), and capex ran at 13.6% of revenue during the 1+N capacity build. The component build is the base; last_fcf is reported on the strict owner-FCF definition for auditability. Normalised FY2025 owner FCF (EBITDA ex-interest 1,767 - cash tax at 25% on EBIT 955 - capex 1,495 - lease 18) is roughly RMB15m; at the FY2026E capex run-rate (~8.5% of revenue) it would be ~RMB580m. H1 2026 owner FCF (~RMB220m) is counted both in the 30 Jun cash and in the year-1 flow; this is small and is offset by discounting year 1 a full period.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF, routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md as a non-US operating consumer-staples company (bottled water / RTD beverages) with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: CNY-built WACC, CNY/HKD quote bridge, lease treatment (B), NCI in the bridge, excluded interest income matched by cash in the bridge, SBC-zero market (house = street, band_position null). The business is shrinking: revenue -18.6% FY2025 and -12.1% H1 2026 after Nongfu Spring's 2024-25 purified-water price war took C'estbon's purified-water share from ~70% to ~45%; the 'second growth curve' beverage line fell 35.4% in H1 2026. The base case therefore models a further decline into FY2027 and stabilisation at a smaller scale, not a recovery to FY2024 margins, and the terminal multiple is capped at 15x. Dividends declared but unpaid at the balance-sheet date (FY2025 final+special, paid 28 Aug 2026; the H1 2026 interim, record date 14 Sep 2026, paid 26 Oct 2026) are deducted in equity_bridge because a buyer at today's price does not receive them. Dividend Plan (24 Jun 2026) commits to at least RMB0.37/share for FY2026-28 (~RMB887m/yr, a ~6% yield at the current price), above the projected owner FCF in every scenario's early years; the shortfall is funded from the cash pile that this model adds to EV, so the plan is consistent with the valuation and is not an additional source of value. The HK$530m repurchase mandate is likewise a redistribution of the bridged cash.

bear.rationale: Share loss has not stopped: H2 2026 matches H1's -12%, FY2027 -8% as Nongfu and Wahaha keep purified water priced as a loss-leader for their broader portfolios, and the beverage line fails to offset. Revenue bottoms around RMB8.0bn in FY2031 (-27% from FY2025). Ex-interest EBITDA margin compresses to 12.5% (H2 2025 was 10.2%) as sponsorship and plant fixed costs sit on a smaller base. Capex 7% ~ maintenance. Terminal growth 1%, terminal FCF still positive so the zero floor is not hit; the cash pile is most of the equity value.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -9.5%: H1 actual -12.1% on H2 2025's already-depressed RMB4,796m base, assuming H2 2026 falls ~5% as discounting eases under the late-2025 anti-involution push. FY2027 -3% as the last of the share loss washes through, flat FY2028, then 1.5-2% — Chinese packaged water grew 2.5% in 2024 (CIC) and C'estbon holds, not regains, its reduced share.
base.margin_rationale: Ex-interest EBITDA margin 16.5% in FY2026 (H1 actual 20.9%, H2 ~12%), lifting to 18% by FY2030 as discounting normalises and sports-sponsorship spend is absorbed on a stable base — below FY2024's 19.5% because the lost volume was the highest-margin small-bottle water and fixed plant cost (Danjiangkou) is spread over less revenue.
base.capex_rationale: 8.5% of revenue in FY2026 (H1 actual 6.6%, Danjiangkou completion and RMB399m of contracted commitments in H2), then 7.5% ~ D&A once the 1+N build completes end-2026. FY2023-25 ran 17.1% / 14.7% / 13.6%.
base.wc_rationale: Negative-working-capital business (payables 3,310 + contract liabilities 176 > receivables 1,118 + inventory 452 at 30 Jun 2026): shrinkage releases nothing and consumes cash. 10% capture on the revenue change means declining years cost cash and growth years release it; FY2025 saw the H1 inflow fully reverse in H2.

bull.rationale: Price war ends in H2 2026 under regulatory pressure; H2 2026 revenue roughly flat YoY so FY2026 -7%. Purified-water share stabilises ~45% and the beverage line (tea, juice, sports) resumes growth from its reset base, taking group revenue growth to 5% in FY2028-29. Margin recovers to 21% by FY2031 (above FY2024's 19.5%) on lower discounting, mix toward beverages and a fully loaded self-owned plant network. Terminal growth 2.5%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30% because the central thesis risk — that C'estbon's share loss has stopped — is unproven: the two most recent prints (FY2025 -18.6%, H1 2026 -12.1%) both fell, the beverage diversification itself fell 35% in H1 2026, and the product is a commodity against larger rivals. Bull cut to 20% because it requires a competitor's pricing discipline, share stabilisation and beverage execution to coincide. Bear is not higher than 30% because the balance sheet (RMB7.3bn cash, RMB13m debt) removes any solvency or refinancing axis and the bear case still generates positive owner FCF.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
